name: WorkMaster 550mm Step Platform Fibreglass Safety Work Ladder
shortDescription: Heavy-duty 150kg rated non-conductive fibreglass step platform ladder with 550mm wide anti-slip deck, high safety rail, and non-skid rubber feet.
overview: The WorkMaster 550mm Step Platform Ladder is an industrial-duty safety access podium engineered for maintenance technicians, electricians, and aircraft engineers who require a stable, hands-free work surface at height. Manufactured with non-conductive pultruded fibreglass channel stiles, it guarantees electrical insulation in high-voltage industrial switchyards and sub-stations. The expansive 550mm wide slip-resistant chequered platform features an integrated high safety guardrail, safety chain gate, and full-width aluminium anti-slip treads, preventing falls and fatigue during extended overhead tasks.
keyFeatures: Non-conductive pultruded fibreglass stiles provide vital dielectric protection for electricians
Extra-wide 550mm x 400mm chequered aluminium platform provides stable 360-degree footing
High wrap-around safety handrail (900mm above platform) with front safety chain
Rated for heavy industrial duty with 150 kg safe working load capacity
Heavy-duty internal steel spreader bars lock the ladder securely in open position
Heavy-gauge non-marking, slip-resistant vulcanized rubber foot shoes
Conforms to EN 131 and ANSI A14.5 industrial ladder safety standards

specifications.Rung / Step Material: Serrated Aluminium Alloy with Deep Ribs
specifications.Electrical Isolation: Tested up to 30 kV Dielectric Strength

applications: High-voltage electrical substation and transformer maintenance
Industrial plant conveyor, crane, and HVAC servicing
Aircraft hangar maintenance and fleet vehicle detailing
Warehouse racking order picking and inventory auditing
